capabilities: Show branch, change counts and ahead/behind state in a status bar indicator
Run status, fetch, pull, commit, push and sync commands from the command palette
Auto-fetch and auto-sync the vault on configurable intervals
Build commit messages from a template with datetime substitution
Locate the Git executable in PATH or a user-configured path
extras: Desktop only (requires Obsidian Desktop v1.8.7+); the vault must already be inside an initialized Git repository; installable via BRAT or manually; UI supports English and Russian.
intentEvidence: By avoiding bundled JavaScript/Wasm Git reimplementations, it ensures maximum performance, security, and native Git semantics.
motivation: The author built it to delegate operations to the system's installed Git executable instead of bundled JavaScript/Wasm Git reimplementations, for performance, security and native Git semantics.
problem: Obsidian has no native Git support, so vaults in Git repositories need a plugin to run status, commit and sync operations from inside the app.
summary: Git integration plugin that runs status, fetch, pull, commit, push and sync through the system Git executable, with a status bar branch indicator.
